programs.name: Music Performance
programs.description: Advanced performance training in classical music. Instrumental or vocal specialization. Solo recitals and ensemble work. Collaboration with Slovak Philharmonic.

programs.name: Theatre Studies
programs.description: Acting, directing, and theatre production. Practical training with the academy's theatre company. History of theatre and dramatic theory.

programs.name: Film and Television Directing
programs.description: Advanced film and TV directing. Documentary, fiction, and experimental film. Collaboration with Slovak film studios and broadcasters.
